newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - CHS estimates raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - CHS estimates raised.

text.p: -- Raymond James & Associates analyst Greg Rinker said he raised his fourth quarter earnings estimate for CHS Electronics Inc to $0.45 a share from $0.32.
-- The computer-equipment wholesaler's shares were up 1-1/2 to 19-1/4.
-- Rinker said he increased his full-year 1997 forecast to $1.47 a share from $1.40.

-- said CHS, which last year bought the European and Latin American distribution businesses of Merisel Inc, was performing better than expected and would likely yield full-year 1996 net earnings of about $11.7 million.
-- He had previously forecast 1996 net of about $10.9 million.

-- He said the company's per-share profits will be helped, too, by a smaller share base. CHS's outstanding shares will be about 12.7 million for 1996, instead of the 15 million estimated earlier, Rinker said.
Several owners of companies acquired by CHS were opting for cash, rather than CHS shares, to settle their deals, Rinker said.

-- CHS Chief Financial Officer Craig Toll said the Miami company knew of no reason for its stock price jump and was planning no announcment until Thursday, when it will issue fourth quarter and full-year 1996 results.
